## History

Nora is described by [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) in a letter as one of his imaginary, whimsical companions near the shore. Together with [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and other fictional friends, she embarks on fantastic adventures, such as traveling into the sunset and sailing into the moon.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)_

## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nora.md)

Nora is one of the imaginary, whimsical companions that [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) details in a letter describing his life near the shore. According to [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), he embarks on fantastic adventures with Nora and his other imaginary companions, including traveling into the sunset and sailing into the moon.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +1 more_
